_what_this_is: Deliberately weaken copied factory trust-root code and require focused anti-bypass tests to go red.
Unlike application mutations, these NEVER edit the live worktree: the runner creates a minimal temporary repo-shaped copy for every defect.
A mutation only counts when its exact anchor is found and the previously-green focused suite fails after injection.

defects.why: A deterministic guard that always says pass makes every other security check advisory.
An autonomous PR could rewrite CI or templates without the deterministic protected-path veto.
